name: approval-guard
label: Approval guard
description: Checks approval writes against the spend policy: duplicates, line totals, a required purchase order, its vendor and open status, and its remaining balance plus tolerance. Runs for store__invoices__set with status approved or recommendation approve, and store__reviews__set with recommendation approve. It reads related rows and blocks a failed check; rows seeded earlier in the same durable run are not yet visible, so tool validation covers those missing-row checks. The chat agent has rw store tools for composite execution. This hook demonstrates policy enforcement, not user authorization. Thresholds mirror amodal/_lib/policy.ts and amodal/knowledge/spend-policy.md.
